desc: Hunters in the market for a reliable bolt-action rifle that keeps value in the crosshairs have come to the right place. The AB3 bolt-action rifle is more than the sum of its parts. It has proven Browning accuracy, design, looks, and the level of performance you are accustomed to from a product that wears the Buckmark logo. This AB3 is built for deep woods whitetail hunters that require an added element of concealment in the stand courtesy of the Mossy Oak Bottomland finish. The barreled action receives a non-reflective matte blued finish. The barrel is threaded M13x.075 for the included radial muzzle brake or an optional Browning Recoil Hawg Sporter can be added for even greater felt recoil reduction (thread protector included). A larger hex-shaped bolt knob is also standard.
